verdict.rationale: Navan's own hosted MCP server lets AI assistants answer policy questions and explain flags and declines: why a transaction was flagged, who must approve it, and what policy applies. That covers the decline-explanation part and gives some basis for pre-spend policy questions, but nothing shows the assistant chasing missing receipts or proactively enforcing policy in conversation. missing for 10: proactive missing-receipt chasing, explicit pre-spend "can I expense this?" checks, independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational enforcement.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens

citations.quote: Ask questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons — understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
